module: Flowgraph node 'Countdown Lights Controller' (repeat_instant category) for the drag race starting light. Turns on the ambers then the green following the time ('Pro' tree: 3 simultaneous ambers at 2.0 s then green at 2.4 s; classic tree: successive ambers, green at 2.5 s). If the vehicle moves more than 0.2 (pin 'distance') before the green, it is a false start: disqualified=true and red lights. Outputs: flow, disqualified, started.
notes: self.lights is only created by initLights, called only on the 'reset' impulse: without a prior reset, work raises an error (indexing nil).
The node's description ('Updates the lights for the Drag Races missions') is the same as that of Lights Controller and UpdateDisplay.
flow is always true on output.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

initLights.desc: Searches the scene for the countdown light objects (Amberlight1-3, Greenlight, Redlight, left/right).

_executionStarted.desc: Resets the state (started, starttimer, jumpStarted, timerOn) and the outputs to zero.

work.desc: On reset: resets the state and hides all lights (initLights). Otherwise advances the timer (dtSim), turns the lights on/off according to proTree, sets started=true at green, detects the false start.
